newsitem.title: CHILE: Li Peng arrives in Chile for Latin American tour.
newsitem.headline: Li Peng arrives in Chile for Latin American tour.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng arrived in Chile on Wednesday on the first stop of a Latin American tour aimed at drumming up China's business and political ties with the region, diplomats said.

Li, met at the airport by Foreign Minister Jose Miguel Insulza, will seek progress on China's long-standing goal to invest in Chile's copper mining industry to help guarantee a share of its copper production for China's booming demand.

"China needs copper. It doesn't have enough copper and so it must import Chilean copper. China is interested in investing here and cooperating with Chile on copper," China's ambassador to Chile, Wang Chengjia, told reporters this week.

Chilean officials have said China hoped to buy an entire copper mine outright but would settle for a large investment and guaranteed share of production in one or more mines. With about a third of global output, Chile is by far the world's largest producer of the metal, used heavily in the building industry.

Li was to meet President Eduardo Frei during his 24-hour visit, sign a technical and scientific cooperation agreement and take a tour through Santiago's Cerro San Cristobal park, which has been spruced up for a summit of 21 Latin American and Iberian leaders starting on Sunday.
Chile has been looking to Asia, particularly China, as the best growth opportunity for exports of copper and fresh fruit.

Chilean officials recently declared victory in a decade-long campaign to eradicate the Mediterranean fruitfly, potentially clearing the way for hundreds of millions of dollars in exports of fruit to Asia.
Li leaves on Thursday for Brazil and will later visit Venezuela.
